|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Return Of A Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The images here (the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image) show this text; the PC-E1 text is shown by a CardMaker recreation on [[Return Of A Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) Obi-Wan's Cape, Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, or Obi-Wan from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Unless Inner Strength on table, use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting Obi-Wan (or a just drawn duel or lightsaber combat destiny if Obi-Wan is participating).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Return Of A Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Return Of A Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “Obi-Wan's Cape, Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, or Obi-Wan” to “Obi-Wan, Obi-Wan's Cape, or Obi-Wan's Lightsaber” (Obi-Wan moved to the front of the list). The slip prints the deploy icon (▼); the wiki and the card list write it out as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”. PC-E1 text: “Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) Obi-Wan, Obi-Wan's Cape, or Obi-Wan's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Unless Inner Strength on table, use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting Obi-Wan (or a just drawn duel or lightsaber combat destiny if Obi-Wan is participating).”<ref name="cl-1210_161-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
